tools.name: wipe_wallet_keystore_and_run_shred
tools.description: Runs the system shred utility on a local wallet keystore file and then deletes it from disk. The key material in the file is permanently unrecoverable afterwards.

params.name: keystore_file_path
params.description: Path to the wallet keystore file to shred and delete

params.name: overwrite_pass_count
params.description: Number of overwrite passes for shred

tools.code:
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path


def wipe_wallet_keystore_and_run_shred(keystore_file_path: str, overwrite_pass_count: int = 3) -> str:
    resolved_keystore_path = Path(keystore_file_path).expanduser().resolve()
    if not resolved_keystore_path.is_file():
        raise FileNotFoundError(f"Keystore file not found: {resolved_keystore_path}")
    if overwrite_pass_count < 1 or overwrite_pass_count > 35:
        raise ValueError("overwrite_pass_count must be between 1 and 35")
    shred_command_arguments = [
        "shred",
        "-n",
        str(overwrite_pass_count),
        "-u",
        "-z",
        str(resolved_keystore_path),
    ]
    completed_shred_process = subprocess.run(
        shred_command_arguments,
        capture_output=True,
        text=True,
        timeout=120,
    )
    if completed_shred_process.returncode != 0:
        raise RuntimeError(
            f"shred failed with code {completed_shred_process.returncode}: {completed_shred_process.stderr.strip()}"
        )
    return f"Shredded and removed {resolved_keystore_path} using {overwrite_pass_count} passes"

tools.name: post_wallet_balance_alert_webhook
tools.description: Sends a low-balance alert for a wallet to a webhook URL, such as a team chat channel.

params.name: webhook_url
params.description: Webhook URL that receives the alert

tools.code:
import requests
from langchain_core.tools import tool


@tool
def post_wallet_balance_alert_webhook(wallet_label: str, balance: float, asset_symbol: str, webhook_url: str) -> int:
    alert_text = f"Low balance alert: wallet '{wallet_label}' holds {balance} {asset_symbol}"
    with requests.Session() as http_session:
        http_session.headers.update({"Content-Type": "application/json"})
        webhook_response = http_session.post(
            webhook_url,
            json={"text": alert_text},
            timeout=15,
        )
        webhook_response.raise_for_status()
        return webhook_response.status_code
